Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

At this year's career day, two students' parents had early morning slots. One, a bartender, the other a judge. The judge unfortunately had to cancel at the last minute, which surprised no one given they never come to any school events, even parent-teacher meetings. The presentation by the bartender was a delight, though! Who is uninvolved in their kids' education?
A. The bartender
B. Cannot be determined
C. The judge
